title: Rs 99 vs Rs 100: ye pricing trick kaam kyun karti hai
description: Har dukaan ye trick use karti hai. Business ke peeche ka dimaag.
voice: Kabhi socha... cheezein nintyaanve rupaye mein kyun bikti hain, sau mein kyun nahi? Iske peeche ek dimaagi trick hai - ise kehte hain charm pricing. Hamara brain keemat ko left se right padhta hai, toh nintyaanve dekhte hi lagta hai - are, sau se kam hai! Farak sirf ek rupaye ka, par bikri kaafi badh jaati hai. Aise hi business ke peeche ka dimaag samajhna hai? Dhandha Dimaag ko follow karo.
